nodes.statement: Equivalent taxicab norms transport exact target AnalyticAt and derivative germs.
Every analytic germ has unique symmetric coefficients with no larger coefficient norms.
B0(Z,G) of summable symmetric positive-degree coefficients is a Banach space; its closed unit ball is complete.
Evaluation of B0 has radius at least one, is analytic on the open ball, and is injective as an analytic germ.
Multilinear superposition lift has norm at most coefficient norm times product of input norms and commutes with evaluation.
Time-primitive A has coefficient norm at most one half.
